name: Made by Matt cross-estate unification

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - index.html
      - assets/mbm-platform.css
      - assets/mbm-platform.js
      - assets/mbm-theme.js
      - assets/mbm-hub.css
      - tools/verify_cross_estate_unification.py
      - tools/verify_cross_estate_browser.mjs
      - docs/MBM_CROSS_ESTATE_UNIFICATION.md
      - .github/workflows/mbm-cross-estate-unification.yml
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - codex/mbm-cross-estate-unification-lessons-apps-2026-08-08
    paths:
      - index.html
      - assets/mbm-platform.css
      - assets/mbm-platform.js
      - assets/mbm-theme.js
      - assets/mbm-hub.css
      - tools/verify_cross_estate_unification.py
      - tools/verify_cross_estate_browser.mjs
      - docs/MBM_CROSS_ESTATE_UNIFICATION.md
      - .github/workflows/mbm-cross-estate-unification.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: mbm-cross-estate-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  announce-live-run:
    if: (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Index this production run on the release PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          gh pr comment 5 --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "Production cross-estate verification started for source \`$GITHUB_SHA\`. Run: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

  static-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact branch under review
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check out the canonical Made by Matt platform
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: MattRoper1977/mattroper1977.github.io
          ref: main
          path: _reference/site
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Verify preservation, local shell and positive control
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          python tools/verify_cross_estate_unification.py --base origin/main --canonical _reference/site --self-test
          python -m json.tool "$([ -f resources.json ] && echo resources.json || echo apps.json)" >/dev/null
          node --check assets/mbm-platform.js
          node --check assets/mbm-theme.js
          node --check tools/verify_cross_estate_browser.mjs
          python - <<'PY'
          import pathlib, re
          text=pathlib.Path('index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/mbm-inline-scripts');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          count=0
          for body in re.findall(r'<script(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</script>',text,re.S|re.I):
              if body.strip():
                  (out/f'inline-{count}.js').write_text(body,encoding='utf-8')
                  count+=1
          print(f'extracted {count} inline script(s)')
          PY
          for script in /tmp/mbm-inline-scripts/*.js; do node --check "$script"; done
          git diff --check origin/main...HEAD

  browser-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact branch under review
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check out canonical root for an accurate mounted-origin test
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: MattRoper1977/mattroper1977.github.io
          ref: main
          path: _reference/site
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Assemble the same-origin project mount
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f resources.json ]; then prefix=Lessons; else prefix=Matt-s-Apps-; fi
          mkdir -p "_served/$prefix"
          rsync -a --exclude=.git _reference/site/ _served/
          rsync -a --exclude=.git --exclude=_reference --exclude=_served --exclude=audit-output ./ "_served/$prefix/"
          echo "$prefix" > /tmp/mbm-prefix

      - name: Install the browser harness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.54.2
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Run responsive, interaction and unchanged-standalone checks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory _served >/tmp/mbm-http.log 2>&1 &
          server=$!
          trap 'kill $server || true' EXIT
          prefix=$(cat /tmp/mbm-prefix)
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:4173/$prefix/" >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
          MBM_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:4173/$prefix/" node tools/verify_cross_estate_browser.mjs

      - name: Print browser evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test ! -f audit-output/browser-results.json || cat audit-output/browser-results.json

      - name: Upload responsive evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mbm-cross-estate-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: audit-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  branch-evidence:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/mbm-cross-estate-unification-lessons-apps-2026-08-08'
    needs: [static-contract, browser-matrix]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Record the approved same-repository branch proof on PR 5
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          gh pr comment 5 --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "Cross-estate static and browser gates passed on exact head \`$GITHUB_SHA\`. Run: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

  live-proof:
    if: (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: [static-contract, browser-matrix]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - name: Check out the merged source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install the production browser harness
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.54.2
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Wait for the exact project deployment
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f resources.json ]; then prefix=Lessons; manifest=resources.json; else prefix=Matt-s-Apps-; manifest=apps.json; fi
          base="https://madebymatt.uk/$prefix/"
          versioned="${base}?mbm=${GITHUB_SHA}"
          mkdir -p audit-output
          printf '{"source":"%s","base":"%s","versioned":"%s"}\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" "$base" "$versioned" > audit-output/deployment-target.json
          ready=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if curl -fsS --retry 2 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, max-age=0' -H 'Pragma: no-cache' -o /tmp/mbm-live-index.html "$versioned" && grep -q 'mbm-cross-estate-unification-lessons-apps-2026-08-08' /tmp/mbm-live-index.html; then
              ready=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          test "$ready" -eq 1
          for route in / /games/ /Lessons/ /Matt-s-Apps-/ /tools/ /resources/; do
            curl -fsS --retry 3 "https://madebymatt.uk$route" >/dev/null
          done
          curl -fsS --retry 3 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, max-age=0' "${base}${manifest}?mbm=${GITHUB_SHA}" | python -m json.tool >/dev/null
          for asset in mbm-platform.css mbm-platform.js mbm-theme.js mbm-hub.css; do
            curl -fsS --retry 3 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, max-age=0' "${base}assets/$asset?mbm=${GITHUB_SHA}" -o "/tmp/$asset"
            cmp "assets/$asset" "/tmp/$asset"
          done
          echo "$base" > /tmp/mbm-live-base

      - name: Prove the served responsive and standalone estate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          MBM_BASE_URL="$(cat /tmp/mbm-live-base)" MBM_CACHE_BUST="$GITHUB_SHA" node tools/verify_cross_estate_browser.mjs

      - name: Record production proof on the release PR
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          gh pr comment 5 --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "Production cross-estate proof passed on merged source \`$GITHUB_SHA\`. Run: https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

      - name: Print live evidence
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test ! -f audit-output/browser-results.json || cat audit-output/browser-results.json

      - name: Upload production evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: mbm-cross-estate-live-${{ github.repository_id }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: audit-output/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
